adaptationNote: Teka Edu adaptation for the DRC (Teka Edu decision, not an official DRC programme): DRC school calendar and holidays, Congolese or universal examples, French-first with optional English scaffolding. The 2026 French programme states objectives by age band (before 4, from 4, from 5); Teka Edu maps its classes to the French sections PS, MS and GS.
